```{r}
library(knitr)
```

# Probability (p-value) of a t-score.
```{r}
t_score = .376
df = 14
Tails = 2

pt(t_score,df, lower.tail = F) * Tails

```


# Get a t-score (t-crit) from a probablity value (p-value or alpha)
```{r}

probability = .025
df = 14

qt(probability, df)


```


# Independent-groups t-test (equal n)
```{r}

EqualIndependentData = rbind(iris[iris$Species == "setosa",],
                             iris[iris$Species == "versicolor",]
                             )

leveneTest(Sepal.Length ~ Species,EqualIndependentData)

t.test(Sepal.Length ~ Species,EqualIndependentData)

```



# Independent-groups t-test (unequal n)
```{r}

SmallVersicolor = iris[iris$Species == "versicolor",]
SmallVersicolor = SmallVersicolor[1:20,]

UnequalIndependentData = rbind(iris[iris$Species == "setosa",],
                               SmallVersicolor
                               )

leveneTest(Sepal.Length ~ Species, UnequalIndependentData)

t.test(Sepal.Length ~ Species, UnequalIndependentData)

```
